test_cases.title: Freeze and inventory the current reference working tree

steps: Prepare identical immutable fixture copies and configuration for Prepomac and the web adapter.
Perform the named operations; exercise the browser for the user-facing path.
Compare the expected outputs, save/reopen and failure behavior; retain both runs and diffs.
expected: Record Git HEAD, dirty/untracked state and SHA-256 of relevant source/test/fixture/build inputs; record SDK, tools, browser and hardware.

A missing, newly added or changed reference test is surfaced for review rather than silently omitted.
test_cases.notes: The original 2026-11-06 baseline was completed and its immutable evidence is retained. The current reference inventory added virtual-friction and dialog-layout verifiers; M00 is reopened for that extension. Current sources/runtime are captured for the material slice, but three new reference verifiers remain not_run.
